integrity: Complete face-poset acyclic matchings, integer incidence reductions and inclusion maps; independently checked mod-two chain complexes; standalone standard-library script included.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification for the specified Frucht graph only; does not classify higher-independence complexes for all cubic graphs or the homotopy classes of the inclusion maps. Full-complex S^3 is previously known; new result concerns the complete vertex-deletion profile and induced integral H3 maps. Equivalent unindexed prior work cannot be ruled out.
title: Integral vertex-deletion homotopy and inclusion profile of the Frucht two-independence complex
